Maya — thanks for the usage snapshot. Great to see the spike numbers. Two quick options to keep you moving:

Option A — Short free extension (10 days):
- We can extend the existing pilot for 10 business days at no charge. This is intended to let you finish the traffic test quickly.
- Limits: same model & concurrency; no additional SLA beyond standard trial support.

Option B — Paid short extension + committed block (preferred for predictable pricing):
- Convert to a 30-day micro-commit: 30M tokens committed, billed monthly.
- Intro price: $0.18 / 1k tokens (list would be $0.24). Effective discount ~25% off list for the first month.
- Includes one dedicated onboarding session (2 engineering hours) and priority queue for staging.

If procurement prefers credits instead of a percentage discount, we can do a $5k credit voucher against the committed block for new customers.

Next steps I suggest: I can push a one-page addendum (no legal redlines) for Option B and loop Karthik for finance approval. If you just need the short test window today, I can enable Option A immediately — no paperwork.

Which path would you prefer? If Option B, I'll attach a short addendum and an SOW stub so procurement has a DocuSign-ready artifact.

Alex
